idea-plugin.name: Phantom JPA
idea-plugin.description: JPA, Hibernate and Spring Data JPA support for Phantom IDEA: and entity mapping checks, repository/entity navigation, JPQL inside Spring Data @Query and @NamedQuery (also through const val / static final constants), with highlighting, entity and attribute navigation, completion and unresolved-name errors. Works for Java and Kotlin. Does nothing in projects without JPA.
